name: Varanasi
summary: A historic river city of ghats, temples, old lanes and museums along the Ganga.

attractions.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
attractions.description: Major temple in the old city; visitor access and queues can vary.

attractions.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
attractions.description: One of the best-known riverfront ghats in Varanasi.

attractions.name: Assi Ghat
attractions.description: Southern riverfront ghat and a popular starting point for walks.

attractions.name: Sarnath Archaeological Museum
attractions.description: Museum near the Sarnath archaeological site; closed Fridays in this sample schedule.

attractions.name: Dhamek Stupa
attractions.description: Large Buddhist stupa at the Sarnath archaeological complex.

attractions.name: Bharat Kala Bhavan Museum
attractions.description: Art and archaeology museum on the Banaras Hindu University campus.

attractions.name: Banarasi Silk Market
attractions.description: Old-city shops and workshops associated with Banarasi weaving.

attractions.name: Tulsi Manas Temple
attractions.description: Temple with inscriptions depicting verses from the Ramcharitmanas.
